The Studio

We create timeless outdoor spaces.

Operating along the Gulf Coast since 2002, GDSI is a turn-key design/build firm. We craft visually stunning, functional landscapes that blend seamlessly into their surroundings — carrying every project from first concept to final planting with a designer's eye and a builder's precision.
